verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a Secretary of State filing service can publish its statutory fee schedule. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows any fee amount for any transaction. The portal items list services (file new business, amendments, renewals, copies, good standing certificates) and a payment rail via US Bank, but none states a dollar figure. The front-door site where a fee schedule might live is behind a CAPTCHA interstitial and yielded no fee content.
